name: business-planning
description: Shared business planning for startups and established companies, with distinct Vera and Clara professional lenses.

interface.shortDescription: Build reviewable strategic or financial business plans.
interface.longDescription: Business Planning supports startups, new ventures and established companies through one shared assumption and handoff contract. In Vera, the accounting-financial lens prepares linked P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, scenarios, funding needs and reconciliation. In Clara, the strategic-commercial lens prepares evidence-linked findings, options, recommendations, initiatives, milestones, KPIs and risks. The two lenses may exchange a reviewed handoff, but neither silently changes the other's assumptions or conclusions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare the accounting and financial business plan for this company from reviewed evidence and assumptions.
Prepare the strategic and commercial business plan for this company from reviewed evidence and assumptions.
Review the counterpart business-planning handoff and surface any inconsistent assumptions before continuing.
